implementerProof.how: Re-ran the implementer's exact command in the issue workspace at the PR head with JJ_CONFIG/JJ_USER/JJ_EMAIL unset: `cd packages/contracts && bun run build; cd ../pi-envoy && bun test extensions/envoy.test.ts -t 'acknowledges an agent-subject|redelivery|targeted BTW|failed receipt publish'` -> 5 pass, 0 fail, 21 expect() calls (matches implement.json red.afterFix); `bun run test` -> 178 pass, 0 fail, 574 expect() calls, Ran 178 tests across 7 files (matches implement.json testSummary). Reproduced the implementer's red independently: `jj file show -r d35e8b5934c6 packages/pi-envoy/extensions/envoy.ts` written over the working copy's envoy.ts, same five-test filter -> 0 pass, 5 fail, each on the missing receipt subject; then `jj restore packages/pi-envoy/extensions/envoy.ts`, sha256 of the restored file equals `jj file show -r c707d3a10f69` (21480b7a0040...). Read each of the five tests: the assertions are recorded call sequences, not timing sleeps.

proof.criterion: Acceptance 1 - receipt before pi.sendMessage and before any fetch to Dispatch, from a recorded call sequence
proof.surface: bun test in packages/pi-envoy (CI job pi-envoy, workflow 'Legion Envoy and Contracts')
proof.command: cd packages/pi-envoy && env -u JJ_CONFIG -u JJ_USER -u JJ_EMAIL bun test extensions/envoy.test.ts -t 'acknowledges an agent-subject request before'
proof.observed: pass; the test arms fetch recording and natsState.onPublish before the push and asserts calls toEqual ['publish _INBOX.receipt', 'sendMessage'] (envoy.test.ts 3952-3989) - no fetch recorded at all, so none preceded the receipt
proof.negativeControl: base deliver() (d35e8b5934c6) against the same test: FAIL, `publish _INBOX.receipt` missing (Expected -1 / Received +0)

proof.criterion: Acceptance 2 - a duplicate (same dedupe_key) is acknowledged and not injected a second time
proof.command: cd packages/pi-envoy && env -u JJ_CONFIG -u JJ_USER -u JJ_EMAIL bun test extensions/envoy.test.ts -t 'deduplicates a redelivery after successful injection'
proof.observed: pass; fixture.messages length 2 and natsState.published subjects toEqual ['_INBOX.first', '_INBOX.duplicate', '_INBOX.next'] (envoy.test.ts 3887-3932)
proof.negativeControl: base deliver(): FAIL, `_INBOX.next` missing when the third injection resolved (the old ack-after-injection order)

proof.criterion: Acceptance 3 - a targeted BTW frame's receipt is published before pi.askEphemeral resolves
proof.command: cd packages/pi-envoy && env -u JJ_CONFIG -u JJ_USER -u JJ_EMAIL bun test extensions/envoy.test.ts -t 'answers a targeted BTW delivery ephemerally'
proof.observed: pass; calls toEqual ['publish _INBOX.btw', 'askEphemeral', 'fetch /api/v1/messages/message-1/reply'] (envoy.test.ts 2866-2939) - the receipt precedes askEphemeral being called, so it precedes it resolving and the Dispatch reply POST
proof.negativeControl: base deliver(): FAIL, `publish _INBOX.btw` missing from the sequence

proof.criterion: Acceptance 4 - pi.sendMessage throws after the receipt: logged with the event id, dedupe key not recorded
proof.command: cd packages/pi-envoy && env -u JJ_CONFIG -u JJ_USER -u JJ_EMAIL bun test extensions/envoy.test.ts -t 'permits redelivery after a failed injection'
proof.observed: pass; console.warn called once with a string containing 'evt-retry-after-failure' and an Error; published subjects toEqual ['_INBOX.failed', '_INBOX.retried', '_INBOX.after']; delivered length 2 (the re-send injected because the key was not recorded) (envoy.test.ts 3819-3885)
proof.negativeControl: base deliver(): FAIL, `_INBOX.failed` and `_INBOX.after` missing - the throw skipped the trailing publish

proof.criterion: Errors table - publishing the receipt itself fails: logged, the rest of deliver() still runs
proof.command: cd packages/pi-envoy && env -u JJ_CONFIG -u JJ_USER -u JJ_EMAIL bun test extensions/envoy.test.ts -t 'failed receipt publish'
proof.observed: pass; natsState.failPublishes = 1 makes the first publish throw PUBLISH_FAILED; messages[0] 'receipt lost' and messages[1] 'receipt kept' both injected; published toEqual ['_INBOX.kept']; one warning naming 'evt-receipt-lost' (envoy.test.ts 3991-4034)
proof.negativeControl: base deliver(): FAIL, published [] (Expected ['_INBOX.kept']) - the trailing publish threw out of deliver() after injection and no 'acknowledge' warning was logged

proof.criterion: Errors table - renderInbound throws: no receipt (structural; renderInbound is tolerant so no test frame can make it throw)
proof.surface: reading packages/pi-envoy/extensions/envoy.ts deliver() at the head
proof.observed: two hunks only: +18 lines inserted directly after `const rendered = renderInbound(raw, sessionID, subject);` (line 465; receipt block at 474-483 under the unchanged guard reply !== '' && subject === agentSubject(sessionID), try/catch logging `[envoy] failed to acknowledge envelope <event_id>`), and -3 lines deleting the trailing publish at the end of deliver(). The receipt block precedes the subscriptionRemovedTopics loop (489), the dedupe check (490-491), armAskReminder (498, workspace base only), inbox.unshift (505), every postDispatchReply (518, 527, 533, 535), pi.askEphemeral (532), and pi.sendMessage (539). grep `.publish(reply)` in envoy.ts matches exactly one line (476). No new import.

proof.negativeControl: n/a - no surface exercised pre-merge by order

proof.criterion: Acceptance 6 - packages/pi-envoy/AGENTS.md overview sentence states the new order
proof.surface: jj diff of the file at the head
proof.observed: one hunk replacing 'The agent pump replies after it accepts the envelope ... after two seconds.' with 'The agent pump replies the moment the envelope is decoded - before the inbox update, any Dispatch call, or the session injection - so the listener's two-second receipt window measures decoding, not the host's turn: a claimed-but-deaf holder still becomes a delivery_failed exception, and a busy one no longer does (LEGION-101). A frame that cannot be decoded is still never acknowledged, and a receipt that fails to publish is logged while delivery continues.' The docs/solutions learning doc's snippet comment likewise now reads 'immediately after renderInbound() returns and before the inbox update, any Dispatch call, or pi.sendMessage'.

proof.criterion: Acceptance 7 - skills/envoy/SKILL.md 'Legion exception lane' paragraph names receipt_timeout, narrows delivery_failed, touches only that paragraph
proof.surface: jj diff of the file at the head
proof.observed: exactly one hunk (@@ -148,11 +148,16 @@) inside '## Legion exception lane', between the unchanged heading and '## Slack'. It defines no_holder (no live session holds the role), delivery_failed ('the message was not forwarded at all - the holder lookup failed, the holder was stale, or the publish errored'), and receipt_timeout ('the listener forwarded the message to a registered, live holder and no receipt arrived inside the window; its payload keeps original_topic, event_id, payload, and the original dedupe_key'), and keeps the liveness-signal / never-add-a-subscriber-or-retry guidance and the 'Raw delivery failures stay out of architect context' sentence.
